info.title: Contoso Bank KB Agent API
info.description: API for querying the Contoso Bank Knowledge Base via Azure AI Foundry agent. Returns grounded answers with citations from KB articles.

post.summary: Ask a question about Contoso Bank products and services
post.description: Sends a question to the Contoso Bank Knowledge Base agent and returns a grounded answer with citations. Use this for questions about account opening, credit cards, loans, internet banking, and foreign exchange.

question.description: The user's question about Contoso Bank products or services
question.example: How do I open a savings account at Contoso Bank?

200.description: Successful response with grounded answer and citations

answer.description: The grounded answer from the knowledge base

citations.description: Source articles referenced in the answer

400.description: Invalid request — missing or empty question
